explanation: The two-job execution is faulty because the top-level corpus includes qualifying demand record n06-r01 with demand_score 9, but Job 2 receives only n06-r02 through n06-r08 in both needs and evidence_sources. The supplied Job 1 source localizes this omission to normalize: its allowed_record_ids list contains n06-r09 and n06-r02 through n06-r08, but not n06-r01, so a stipulated qualifying record is silently dropped before the upstream handoff. Job 2 appears to preserve and rank the handoff it actually received, but the handoff was already incomplete, causing the final recommendation to prioritize n06-r07 instead of the missing unsupported highest-demand n06-r01.
